run_profiler_context_manager: run the maybe_run_profiler context manager to profile a PyTorch module with memory snapshots and trace collection
convert_perfetto_to_html: convert a perfetto JSON trace file to an interactive HTML viewer using the perfetto_to_html function
create_profiler_args_config: create a ProfilerArgs config to enable profiling with custom warmup and step counts for memory and trace collection
use_pytorch_profiler_wandb: use PyTorchProfilerWandb to profile PyTorch operations and automatically log trace HTML to Weights and Biases
use_mem_snapshot_profiler_wandb: use MemSnapshotsProfilerWandb to capture memory snapshots and log the memory trace plot HTML to Weights and Biases
